name: ROAMING
title: Move with your body (Roaming)
description: Android app only: listens to the motion broadcasts of the Roaming app (drsounds/roaming-android-app) and moves the bather when you walk, run or lean, speeding up with the motion and gliding to a stop. Camera arm gestures raise or lower the waves, turn them or change the sway; every motion can be remapped.
